title: 第3554章 道友得饶人处且饶人第3553章 你的选择是什么
slug: 多子多福这个世界美女太多
content_zh:
沈青捂着捂着胸口，挣扎着站了起来，疼的龇牙咧嘴，看向李长生的眼神满是恐惧。
除了恐惧，还有疯狂：
“小子.......”
“在我傀儡宗山门之前，竟然还敢大放厥词......”
“今日老子就让你知道什么是生不如死。”
听到这话，李长生眼睛忽然亮了起来：
“比如呢？”
沈青冷哼一声：
“比如......”
但话刚说了一半，他似乎想到了什么，面色涨成了猪肝色：
“废话少说，今天你死定了。”
说话间，他手中光芒闪耀，一枚玉简出现在手中。
刚要催动，却砰的一声，玉简瞬间炸裂。
李长生没有动，但是双眼之中却有幽芒闪过。
他无奈的摇了摇头：
“确实......废话有点多了。”
“既然你不做选择，那本座就帮你做选择吧。”
“不过，我的选择可能不如你的心意哦......”
说话间，李长生也眼神忽然变得凌冽，抬手轻轻一挥，顿时一道恐怖的劲风出现，朝着沈青的丹田而去。
沈青面色大变：

“你......你想击碎我的丹田？”
来不及说更多，沈青连忙朝着旁边躲闪，同时为了保险，再次召唤出两尊傀儡。
这两尊不是青铜战傀，而是拥有肉身的傀儡。
两尊傀儡猛地抬头看向李长生，身上同样释放出神帝波动。
他们没有出手，而是挡在了沈青面前。
李长生扯了扯嘴角，心中暗道：
“看来这傀儡宗确实财大气粗啊。”
“一个小小的外门执事，竟然能够拿出这么多神帝级别的傀儡。”
“也不知道是傀儡宗真的如此富裕，还是说这是沈老傀给这家伙的......”
又是噗噗两声，两尊傀儡倒在了地上，从腰部直接断成了两截。
他们瞪大了眼睛，依旧死死瞪着李长生，随后也暗中光芒逐渐熄灭。
虽然有两人阻挡，但是李长生释放而出的力量依然没有消散，继续朝着沈青冲去。
沈青只感觉头皮发麻，脚上的鞋子开始闪耀光芒，迈动脚步，身影朝着山门冲去。
看来，那鞋子也是一件了不得的法宝。
content_en:
Shen Qing clutched her chest and struggled to stand up. She grimaced in pain and looked at Li Changsheng with eyes full of fear.
In addition to fear, there is also madness:
"Boy..."
"How dare you speak nonsense in front of the gate of my puppet sect..."
"Today I will let you know what life is worse than death."
Hearing this, Li Changsheng's eyes suddenly lit up:
"What about?"
Shen Qing snorted coldly:
"For example..."
But just halfway through speaking, he seemed to have thought of something, and his face turned the color of pig liver:
"Stop talking nonsense, you are dead today."
As he spoke, light shone in his hand, and a jade slip appeared in his hand.
Just when he was about to activate it, there was a bang and the jade slip exploded instantly.
Li Changsheng did not move, but a faint light flashed in his eyes.
He shook his head helplessly:
"It's true... there's a lot of nonsense."
"Since you don't make a choice, I will help you make a choice."
"However, my choice may not be what you want..."
As he spoke, Li Changsheng's eyes suddenly turned sharp. He raised his hand and waved lightly, and a terrifying strong wind suddenly appeared and headed towards Shen Qing's Dantian.
Shen Qing's expression changed drastically:
"You...you want to break my Dantian?"
Without enough time to say more, Shen Qing quickly dodged to the side, and at the same time summoned two puppets again for safety.
These two are not bronze war puppets, but puppets with physical bodies.
The two puppets suddenly raised their heads to look at Li Changsheng, and they also released the God-Emperor Wave.
They did not take action, but stood in front of Shen Qing.
Li Changsheng twitched the corners of his lips and thought to himself:
"It seems that this Puppet Sect is indeed wealthy."
"A small outer sect deacon can actually produce so many god-emperor level puppets."
"I don't know if the Puppet Sect is really so wealthy, or if this is what Old Puppet Shen gave to this guy..."
With two more pops, the two puppets fell to the ground and were broken into two pieces from the waist.
Their eyes widened, still staring at Li Changsheng, and then the light gradually went out in the dark.
Although there were two people blocking him, the power released by Li Changsheng still did not dissipate and he continued to rush towards Shen Qing.
Shen Qing felt his scalp numb, and the shoes on his feet began to shine. He took steps and rushed towards the mountain gate.
It seems that the shoes are also a great magic weapon.
